title: Soybean root · published single-nucleus RNA atlas
genomeBuildEvidence: Williams 82 v4 reported by the source paper; source feature IDs retain the ann1. prefix. No cross-build gene mapping is performed.
geneAliasRule: Only remove the literal ann1. prefix, retaining the original sourceGeneId alongside the alias; case-sensitive and no cross-build or symbol matching.
warnings: Published celltype values are RNA cluster identifiers, not biological cell-type annotations.
This is a processed root reference from two sample IDs (rt3 and rt4), not a newly uploaded experimental dataset.
Existing UMAP and clusters were computed by the authors. Celloras does not recompute them during import.
The current marker-evidence collection uses a different genome build; it cannot automatically validate this atlas's gene identities.
